Extract births with known parents to unpartnered mothers

Source: R/augment_histories.R
extract_unpartnered_births.Rd

Return births where the mother was outside both cohabitation and marriage, with parent ages and optional groups supplied by augment_persons().

Usage

extract_unpartnered_births(population)

Arguments

population

A hammel_population with person and union histories, such as the result of run_simulation().

Value

A separate tibble containing selected person rows and age_mother, age_father, plus group_mother and group_father when groups are present. Input order, column types and custom person columns are preserved. Empty results retain the enriched schema. The population is not modified.

Examples

population <- generate_uniform_population(1000)
model <- hammel_model() |>
  set_population(population) |>
  set_mortality(usa_2000_mortality) |>
  set_fertility(usa_2000_fertility_union) |>
  set_union_formation(
    "rate",
    rates = usa_2000_marriage,
    matching = age_gap_matching_model(3, 5)
  )
result <- run_simulation(model, years = 50, seed = 42)
extract_unpartnered_births(result)
